cohort: The participants are 126 women aged 18-45 with a diagnosis of Abnormally Invasive Placenta.
finding: Psychological flexibility significantly correlated with trauma symptoms, explaining 45.3% of the variance in trauma scores, suggesting it may mediate PTSD severity in women with Abnormally Invasive Placenta, while birth satisfaction was not significantly related to PTSD likelihood.
cross-section timing: Not specified, but involved a retrospective questionnaire administered at a single point in time after birth.
